name: post-success descriptor insertion removed
reason: Every descriptor registration prepares before metadata success. Native/generic/alias/implicit fresh paths also prepare before their provider call; initial adoption receives caller-owned replicas and retains original rejection retirement.

name: unordered descriptor/bucket protocol removed
reason: Ordered stable nodes need no destination bucket capacity or outstanding bucket protocol.

name: descriptor installation cannot grow
reason: Installation transfers already allocated nodes or swaps an existing value.

name: identical descriptors do not allocate nodes
reason: The authoritative value witnesses an unchanged descriptor; no paid duplicate is needed.

name: old unpaid commit facade removed
reason: Actual Data and its deleter retain original accounting through real free.

name: old Qt commit descriptor arrays removed
reason: Prepared changes use actual requested capacity in the same Data lifetime.

name: duplicate post-install History arrays removed
reason: Commit uses existing proof/change inputs; restore uses original target inputs.

name: old allocated preparation claim removed
reason: Both commit and abort hold the original synchronous stack record across owner unlocks.

name: claim disposal restores original owner gate
reason: The record is unlinked under the same authority even on exceptional exit.

name: incremental default revision import removed
reason: The complete original high-water index is paid and prepared atomically.

name: default preparation precedes initialization
reason: A new storage refusal happens before irreversible owner/root configuration.

name: native duplicate descriptor value removed
reason: The original page claim/session protects its borrowed stable node until cancellation or sealing ends use.

name: all original descriptor paths migrated
reason: Implicit default, native alias/fresh, initial adoption, generic fresh and recoverable handoff share the node policy.

name: descriptor revalidation retained
reason: Concurrent semantic edits still invalidate commit/restore candidates.

name: actual identity/metadata/backing refusals retained
reason: Only eliminated storage failure sources are removed; real owner/claim/conflict policies remain.

name: outer Qt and epoch consumers retained
reason: This package does not qualify remaining public Qt projection or epoch/bootstrap storage.

name: real hard-capacity and final tail assertions
reason: Original owners see actual budget refusal, exact node transfer at full capacity and final accounting release.

name: temporary diagnostics absent
reason: Only the final build without diagnostic instrumentation qualifies.
